      How to Play
      
        
      
          
      
            
              
      W A S DMove (double-tap W to sprint)
      
              
      SpaceJump / swim up (creative: double-tap to fly)
      
              
      ShiftSprint (creative: fly faster)
      
              
      CSneak, fly down, stand up from a cushion
      
              
      Left mouseMine blocks, attack
      
              
      Right mousePlace, use, eat (hold), sit, sleep
      
              
      Middle mousePick block (creative)
      
              
      1–9 / wheelSelect hotbar slot
      
              
      EInventory
      
              
      QDrop item (Shift+Q: whole stack)
      
              
      MMap
      
              
      TChat (multiplayer)
      
              
      F3Debug info
      
              
      F1Hide HUD (screenshots)
      
              
      EscPause / close
      
                  
          
      
          
      
            
      First day
      
            
      Punch a tree for logs, turn them into planks and a crafting table, then make a wooden pickaxe. Build a shelter and craft torches from coal and sticks before the first night: zombies and creepers come out in the dark.
      
            
      Wilderness Bound
      
            
      Look for the autumn-colored Dappled Forest near cold regions. Its tall poplar trees come in red, orange and yellow and drop leaves as you walk under them. Collect shelf mushrooms from poplar trunks and fallen logs for stew.
      
            
      Abandoned camps sit around a poplar ringed with fences: tents, a campfire with cushions you can sit on, barrels and a chest holding an explorer map to the next camp. Sleep through the night in a one-use straw bed. Wool and concrete now come in 16 colors, with slabs and stairs.
      
            
      Building and farming
      
            
      Right-click doors, trapdoors and fence gates to open them. Walk into a ladder or hold Space to climb it. Click high on a wall to place a slab on the top half or stairs upside down; put a slab on a slab for a full block.
      
            
      Till grass with a hoe, plant wheat seeds from tall grass and harvest ripe wheat for bread. Sleep in a red bed to skip the night and set your respawn point.
      
            
      Animals and gear
      
            
      Feed two animals of a kind (wheat; seeds for chickens) for a baby. Milk cows with a bucket; shear sheep for wool. Hold right-click to draw a bow, let go to shoot. Wear armor by right-clicking it or putting it in the slots beside your character.
      
            
      Inventory: click to pick up or place, right-click to split or place one, Shift-click to move quickly.
